_comment: Phase 8 close-out (plans/260809-2040-erp-ui-clean-sync-complete/phase-08-close-out.md): explicit, individually-justified debt for inline-style literals that have NO matching CMC token — not a silent count. Each entry is matched structurally (file + property + exact literal value) by scripts/ui-ratchet.mjs and excluded from the violation count. Do NOT add an entry for a literal that DOES have a token match — fix it instead (see the mapping tables used by Phase 7's module slices).
